settings.question: How long does one Pawlio last?
settings.answer: The tin says up to 12 months, but essential oils fade faster with baths, rain and heat. For steady protection we recommend a fresh Pawlio every [months] months — or keep Subscribe & Save on and we'll send the next one automatically.

settings.question: Is it safe for my dog?
settings.answer: Pawlio is made with essential oils and sits on your dog's collar, not on the skin. It's designed for everyday wear on dogs 12 weeks and older. Watch your dog for the first 48 hours and remove the clip if you notice any irritation. If your dog is pregnant, nursing, elderly or on medication, check with your vet first. For dogs only — never use on cats.

settings.question: Will it fit my dog?
settings.answer: Yes. Pawlio clips onto most everyday collars and is suitable for dogs of every size — from chihuahuas to huskies. No trimming needed.

settings.question: Can my dog get wet with it on?
settings.answer: Yes. Pawlio is water-resistant, so rainy walks and bath time are fine. Frequent swimming can make the essential oils fade sooner — another reason we recommend a fresh one every [months] months.

settings.question: How does Subscribe & Save work?
settings.answer: Subscribe & Save is selected by default so your dog never runs out of protection. You pay the discounted price today, and a fresh pack ships every [months] months at that same lower price. Prefer a single order? Pick One-time purchase before adding to cart. Skip, pause or cancel anytime from your account — no fees.

settings.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Log in to your account, open Subscriptions and click Cancel — it takes less than a minute. Need a hand? Email us and we'll do it for you.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days and typically arrive in 7–12 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: What if it doesn't work for us?

settings.question: Can I use it with other flea treatments?
settings.answer: Please ask your vet before combining Pawlio with any other flea or tick product.
